def test_words_in_sentence():
    # Only words whose length is a prime number are kept
    assert words_in_sentence("This is a test") == "is"
    assert words_in_sentence("lets go for swimming") == "go for"

    # Single words of prime length
    assert words_in_sentence("is") == "is"          # length 2 (prime)
    assert words_in_sentence("cat") == "cat"        # length 3 (prime)
    assert words_in_sentence("hello") == "hello"    # length 5 (prime)

    # Single words of composite length are dropped
    assert words_in_sentence("test") == ""          # length 4
    assert words_in_sentence("banana") == ""        # length 6
    assert words_in_sentence("swimming") == ""      # length 8

    # One-letter words are excluded (1 is not prime)
    assert words_in_sentence("a") == ""
    assert words_in_sentence("I am a boy") == "am boy"

    # Mixed lengths, original order preserved
    assert words_in_sentence("go test for") == "go for"
    assert words_in_sentence("apple banana cherry") == "apple"  # 5, 6, 6

    # Long prime-length word (11 letters)
    assert words_in_sentence("programming") == "programming"
    assert words_in_sentence("programming test") == "programming"

    # All words prime length / duplicates preserved
    assert words_in_sentence("go for it") == "go for it"
    assert words_in_sentence("cat cat dog") == "cat cat dog"

    # Empty sentence
    assert words_in_sentence("") == ""
